text:
Priya: Quick sync — drafting recruitment for a Private On‑Prem Beta cohort. Goal: 6 partners (mix of fintech, health, infra-heavy). 8-week pilot. Primary success = production-quality perf (p90 latency, token cost delta <=15%). Secondary = integration effort <= 40 engineering hours/customer. Screening + incentive suggestions?

Sam: +1 on 6 partners. Suggest 2 tiers: 3 early integrators (deep infra help) + 3 light integrations (API-only). Screening needs: infra footprint, compliance needs, team size, expected QPS.

Evan: FYI, for on-prem we need kernel compatibility checklist and an install window for the first deploy. Also call out minimum GPU spec. If anyone expects <2xA10 runtime we should flag.

Maya: For feedback cadence: weekly touchpoints first 3 weeks, then biweekly. We'll run a 4-part eval set: latency regressions, hallucination/regression tests, cost-per-token, integration friction survey. Short example eval snippet:
```
Eval: 50 prompts from customer corpus
metrics: p50/p90 latency, generation-accuracy@threshold, tokens-per-inference
```

Jordan: Legal note — customers must sign a Data Collection Addendum for telemetry (anonymized platform metrics only). Also request an explicit rollback SLA (48h) if regressions hit customer traffic. I'll loop in Legal.

Priya: Incentives thought: 3 months of discounted Dedicated capacity OR $10k engineering credit + 40 hours of SE time for integration + priority feature triage. Also offer co-marketing if success criteria met. Thoughts? :thumbsup:

Sam: Agree. I'll draft the screening form and the outreach message. Draft screening Qs: 1) primary use-case, 2) infra (on-prem cloud, k8s, baremetal), 3) expected peak QPS, 4) compliance needs, 5) contact person + SLA owner.

Sam: Outreach snippet draft: "Hi — Redwood Product team here. We're running a short on‑prem beta to validate private deployment and perf guarantees. We'd love your help as a design partner; rewards include engineering credits, dedicated SE support, and roadmap influence. Interested? Quick form: <link>"

Evan: Also add a question about data residency + whether they can accept nightly anonymized telemetry. We need that to validate caching/batch gains.

Maya: For acceptance criteria, propose pass/fail gates:
- Perf gate: p90 latency within 1.3x of hosted baseline for 90% of evaluation runs
- Stability gate: no increased error rate >0.5% over baseline
- Integration gate: demoed end-to-end in staging within 4 weeks
If any gate fails -> escalation + mitigation plan.

Jordan: I'll prepare a short consent template Legal can sign off on. Also recommend we include a clear opt-out clause for marketing.

Priya: Owners: Sam -> screening + outreach (deadline Mon EOD), Evan -> infra checklist + deploy window (Wed), Maya -> eval harness + prompts (Wed), Jordan -> legal template (Thu). I'll consolidate and send the invite list.

dp-bot: Survey created: "On‑Prem Beta Intake" — link posted in #product, form ID 09xA.

Priya: Thanks team. Next sync Thurs 10am to triage first responses. If anyone can't make, drop updates in the thread. :rocket:
